signal: AtScale completed its largest equity financing led by Snowflake Ventures in Dec 2025 and appointed a new CRO in March 2026 to accelerate enterprise adoption

email.body1:
Joe, saw AtScale's largest-ever round led by Snowflake Ventures and the new CRO brought in to accelerate enterprise adoption.

A fresh raise and a new revenue leader usually means more enterprise accounts in play than the team can cover before reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for AtScale off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Joe, quick follow-up for AtScale.

With a new CRO and Snowflake-backed capital, the pipeline expectation on sales tends to climb faster than headcount can. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need booked to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late in the quarter.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings AtScale needs to hit target, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Joe, last bit of proof for AtScale.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how AtScale's reply rate likely compares to other enterprise data-platform companies. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Joe, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling enterprise pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Ramping a new GTM motion after a raise is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to an enterprise motion? I'll tailor it to AtScale either way.
